GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on well without threatening # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 750m, Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, kept battling in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early stages.] # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped a runner. Travelled keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Not pushed early & raced 5th on inside (3L from lead). Stayed same until improving on inside from 550m. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & worked to challenge leader @ 100m. Did best in last 50m. # Had perfect run.
Jumped Ok Ridden Along Settled Down 4th Inside 4 Lengths same to straightening up Hard Ridden clear run home couldn't quicken - # had its chance
Little Slow Out Went Forward Settled Down Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths but Soon After trav too keen , Ridden Along x 400m, Held Ground to 60m, Couldn'T Go On - cost itself - # too keen
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted at the barriers. Over raced in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly & bumped @ start. Restrained to race behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 200m & chased steadily in last 100m. # Honest effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near the 800m steadied off heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken @ 300m. Chasing Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. No improvement in straight. # Fair effort.

Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths turning, fairly one-paced in straight. [Stewards: Jockey reported it raced flat and did not finish the race off in its usual manner. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that his mount raced flat and did not finish the race off in its usual manner. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer advised that he report back to the Stewards on the gelding’s recovery in the coming days.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths turning, shifted around heels 275m, kept battling to post # battled on ok
Jumped Ok sat box seat 3l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, running on took over 100m and drew clear # had run/too good
Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 4th all of 2 Lengths @ 600m. all Clear on Straightening Up . loomed 200m then maybe peaked a little. Tight late # given Every Chance
